about: Golden corpus for crates/kb-code-server/src/prose_refs.rs (kbc-prose/1). De-identified sentences shaped like a real review run's finding texts. Spans are UTF-16 code-unit offsets into `text` (the consumer is the SPA, which slices JS strings). Refs are listed in span order, exactly as `extract` emits them on the wire (resolution fields are per-request and NOT pinned here). The SPA has NO mirror of this grammar — it consumes the server's refs — so this fixture is walked by the Rust golden test only.
